meta.name: [LADA Decensored] Miss A University's Rui-chan Got a Job Offer Through Pillow Talk! Facial Stream With Old Men, Social Media Viral, Life Over. Rui Ichimiya
meta.description: Rui, a beautiful college student, won the Miss Grand Prix title by seducing an executive at the TV station hosting the university pageant. While she cunningly secured the trophy, she acted as if it were all her own merit. Two runners-up, who despised her, plotted to socially ruin her and completely destroy her dignity.
